Acceso (acceso.design)

Purpose:
- A curated directory of independent industrial and furniture design studios.
- Supporting discovery by designer/entity pages, location pages, and project galleries.

Content structure:
- /designers : directory entry point
- /designers/{slug} : studio/entity pages (primary)
- /designers/in/{place} : location pages (city or country)
- /projects : project gallery index
- /projects/{slug} : individual project pages
- /events/* : events listings and detail pages

Crawl guidance:
- Prefer canonical, clean URLs without query strings.
- Avoid crawling URLs with query parameters (e.g. /designers?city=...).
- Pages requiring authentication are not indexable.

Sitemaps:
- /sitemap.xml (sitemap index)

Robots:
- /robots.txt

Notes:
- Pages are server-rendered HTML (Astro SSR) and should be accessible without client-side JavaScript.
